card.title: How To Repair an iPhone 14 Bootlooping due to IR Camera

source.title: How To Repair an iPhone 14 Bootlooping due to IR Camera

symptoms: auto powers on with DC supply

claims.statement: An iPhone 14 that powers on by itself on a DC supply and loops can have a shorted IR camera in the TrueDepth assembly; it boots normally with the front camera flex unplugged.
Replacing the module fixes the loop, but Face ID stays disabled unless re-paired through authorised calibration.

procedure: Inspect the front camera flex near the IR sensor.
Watch DCPS for auto-boot and looping.
Unplug the front camera flex and test boot.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
